description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of sentences (in thousands) across various categories within the SALT dataset, with the y-axis representing the number of sentences in thousands (K) ranging from 0 to 1000 in increments of 200, and the x-axis listing the categories: Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, Science, and Blogs. The tallest bar corresponds to the "News" category, which contains 902 thousand sentences, followed by "Administrative" with 525 thousand sentences. Other categories include "Non-fiction" with 190 thousand sentences, "Science" with 110 thousand, "Religion" with 50 thousand, "Fiction" with 35 thousand, "Law" with 23 thousand, and "Blogs" with only 2 thousand sentences. The bars are arranged in descending order of sentence count from left to right, with the "News" category significantly exceeding all others in volume.
